name: Punter Rory

intro.text: In Oxford we stand at the sloping end, as God and the Cherwell intended. The Cambridge lot stand on the till. Shocking.

win: Splash! I should have seen that coming. It's in the pole's nature to stick in the mud.
after: Never let go of the pole if it sticks in the mud. You'll either be pulled out of the punt or lose your pole. Everybody has done it once.
